tasks.name: Setup Project Structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with necessary folders and files.

tasks.name: Design Database Schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store tasks with attributes like title, description, priority, and completion status.

tasks.name: Implement Task Creation
tasks.description: Develop functionality to add new tasks to the application.

tasks.name: Implement Task Editing
tasks.description: Develop functionality to edit existing tasks.

tasks.name: Implement Task Deletion
tasks.description: Develop functionality to delete tasks from the application.

tasks.name: Implement Task Prioritization
tasks.description: Develop functionality to set and update task priority levels.

tasks.name: Implement Task Completion
tasks.description: Develop functionality to mark tasks as completed.

tasks.name: Create Frontend UI
tasks.description: Design and implement the user interface for the application.

tasks.name: Integrate Frontend with Backend
tasks.description: Connect the frontend UI with backend services to enable task management.

tasks.name: Testing
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure all functionalities work as expected.

tasks.name: Deployment
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a server or cloud platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Define folder structure for backend, frontend, and shared resources. Create configuration files for dependencies and environment variables.
T1.notes: Follow best practices for project organization (e.g., MVC for backend).

T2.implementation_approach: Identify entities and relationships. Create tables with appropriate fields, data types, and constraints. Normalize schema to avoid redundancy.
T2.notes: Consider scalability and indexing for performance optimization.

T3.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to accept task creation requests. Validate input, store data in the database, and return a success response.
T3.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to update task details. Validate input, locate the task in the database, and apply updates.
T4.notes: Implement partial updates using PATCH method if required.

T5.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to delete tasks. Validate task ID, locate the task in the database, and remove it.

T6.implementation_approach: Add a priority field to the task schema. Create an API endpoint to update task priority based on user input.
T6.notes: Use enums or predefined values for priority levels.

T7.implementation_approach: Add a completion status field to the task schema. Create an API endpoint to mark tasks as completed.
T7.notes: Log timestamps for completion if required.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a responsive frontend using a framework. Implement components for task creation, editing, deletion, prioritization, and completion.

T9.implementation_approach: Connect frontend components to backend API endpoints using HTTP requests. Handle responses and update UI accordingly.
T9.notes: Implement loading states and error handling for better UX.

T10.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for both frontend and backend. Use testing frameworks to automate test execution.
T10.notes: Ensure high test coverage and test edge cases.

T11.implementation_approach: Deploy backend and frontend to a cloud platform. Configure CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
